question: Which Indian satellite launched from French Guiana in early 2019 is the 40th Communication Satellite of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**GSAT-31.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **GSAT-31, India's 40th communication satellite**, was successfully launched into orbit by an **Arianespace Ariane 5 **rocket from the** Kourou launch site in French Guiana.**
 
• The GSAT-31,** weighing 2,535 kg,** would boost **Ku-band transponder capacity **in geostationary orbit.
 
• GSAT-31, which has a** 15-year mission life,** will serve VSAT networks, television uplinks, digital satellite news gathering, DTH television services, cellular backhaul connectivity, and other applications.
 
• The GSAT-31 will ensure that **operational services of some in-orbit satellites **are not disrupted.
 
• The two Ku-band beacon** downlink signals** are transmitted by the satellite for** ground tracking purposes.**
